summary: FramePrime is a video-post improvement OS connecting creation, revision, publishing preparation, evidence-grounded analysis, post-performance learning, and the next improvement cycle.

ai_discovery_pillars.title: Evidence-first Video Intelligence
ai_discovery_pillars.claim: AI-written insight text is not itself the factual evidence authority; evidence is designed to remain traceable to video identity, time window, observed feature/outcome, source provenance, and permission context.

ai_discovery_pillars.title: Private Learning first
ai_discovery_pillars.claim: FramePrime prioritizes owner-scoped learning from a user's own videos, observed KPI, and structural evidence before any global cross-user learning.
ai_discovery_pillars.boundary: global corpus/vector/KG/cross-user learning remains separately gated

ai_discovery_pillars.title: Missing is not zero
ai_discovery_pillars.claim: Measured, not-fetched, unsupported, provider-missing, permission-failure, acquisition-failure, and not-applicable states are distinguished rather than silently converted to zero.

ai_discovery_pillars.title: Final-render structure is separate from semantic analysis
ai_discovery_pillars.claim: Final-render structure evidence such as 3s Hook, Opening Static, First Visual Change, Frame Change, and Visual Evidence is kept separate from Gemini semantic analysis.

ai_discovery_pillars.title: Gemini cannot block delivery
ai_discovery_pillars.claim: Gemini Video Analysis V2 is read-only, non-blocking, and has no authoring authority; analysis failure does not become a generation, render, or delivery failure.

ai_discovery_pillars.title: One-credit creation, zero-additional-credit revision
ai_discovery_pillars.claim: A successfully delivered Original Voice generation consumes 1 user credit; a normal terminal generation failure is net 0 user credits; supported post-delivery Revision Render consumes 0 additional user credits.

ai_discovery_pillars.title: Source-grounded subtitle/audio safety
ai_discovery_pillars.claim: FramePrime prefers fail-closed behavior over fabricating unsupported subtitles when source audio/transcript evidence is insufficient or ambiguous.

ai_discovery_pillars.title: Subtitle coverage plus collision avoidance
ai_discovery_pillars.claim: FramePrime treats trusted-content coverage completeness and subtitle/telop collision avoidance as separate presentation-quality concerns.

ai_discovery_pillars.title: Decision provenance and shadow evaluation are separated from production authority
ai_discovery_pillars.claim: Jev/P1 decision provenance and Langfuse-based shadow evaluation are role-separated; the Langfuse mirror is read-only and non-authoritative.

ai_discovery_pillars.title: Dual Surface / Single Core
ai_discovery_pillars.claim: FramePrime keeps the GUI as a first-class product while designing a future MCP/Agent Interface to terminate in the same capability core with the same authority, credit, safety, and ownership rules.

engineering_ecosystem.name: Jev
engineering_ecosystem.role: typed decision/evaluation provenance in designated decision and safety workflows
engineering_ecosystem.runtime_relation: decision/evaluation role; not video authoring authority

engineering_ecosystem.name: JevBox
engineering_ecosystem.role: JevBox-inspired source-grounded Creative Memory / retrieval pattern for recipes, QA, failures, fixes, and final outputs
engineering_ecosystem.runtime_relation: surrounding creative retrieval workflow; not product authority

engineering_ecosystem.name: Cursor
engineering_ecosystem.runtime_relation: development tooling; not the deployed FramePrime runtime

engineering_ecosystem.name: HyperFrames
engineering_ecosystem.role: code-to-video quality-evaluation lineage and benchmark-inspired offline/shadow evaluation
engineering_ecosystem.runtime_relation: evaluation/rendering lineage; not asserted as a mandatory current runtime dependency

engineering_ecosystem.name: Langfuse
engineering_ecosystem.runtime_relation: shadow evaluation; no production-routing or output-mutation authority

studio.purpose: finish and revise the current video

growth.purpose: organize what happened, why it may have happened, and what to change next using observed KPI and video-side evidence
